name: Meiko Ibarazaki
source:
Meiko is [url=/c757]Emi[/url]'s mother. She appears briefly in Rin's route, and features more prominently in Emi's. She appears rather young and attractive, and has been described by Hisao as an older version of Emi, after observing that she acts very much like her daughter.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Katawa_Shoujo]Wikipedia[/url].]
